criteria.name: theme_asset_alignment
criteria.description: Backgrounds and imagery are unified around technology, teamwork, learning, and skill management, with no random/off-topic image sources.

criteria.name: component_consistency
criteria.description: Cards, buttons, filters, tooltips, nav, and form states share one dark design language.

criteria.name: state_quality
criteria.description: Empty, loading, error, disabled, hover, focus, and active states are clear and consistent.

criteria.name: logic_preservation
criteria.description: Existing app behavior and data flow remain unchanged apart from UI semantics/copy.

criteria.name: runtime_quality
criteria.description: Tests/build and browser smoke pass without visible layout breakage or console errors caused by the change.
